note: TWO BASES. `scaled` multiplies the unembedding side by the final RMSNorm learnable scale model.norm.weight, which is the basis the logits are actually read in; `plain` omits it, which is what D108/D110/D111 used. The 1/||x|| part of RMSNorm is a per-destination scalar shared across all sources, so it cannot reorder anything -- only g can. SCALED IS PRIMARY.
